china.name: China Health

climate.name: Climate Stress
climate.description: Global temp anomaly: 1.11°C above 20th century avg (2026)

supply_chain.name: Supply Chain Health
supply_chain.description: Using Brent oil as supply chain cost proxy — Cass Freight Index not available on FRED
supply_chain.note: Proxy indicator — Baltic Dry Index or Cass Freight would be better. Phase 2 will add direct source.

cyber.name: Cyber Threat Level
cyber.description: Baseline: Elevated. Assessed during daily echo scan via web search for recent CISA/ENISA alerts.
cyber.note: Lumina assesses during daily echo scan by searching for recent CISA alerts, major breach events, and ENISA threat reports. Updated daily.

inst_trust.name: Institutional Trust
inst_trust.description: Baseline: ~30% trust in government (Edelman 2025). Assessed quarterly + during deep scans.
inst_trust.note: Lumina updates during weekly deep scan via web search for latest polls and trust surveys. Quarterly baseline from Edelman Trust Barometer.

ai_acceleration.name: AI Acceleration
ai_acceleration.description: Baseline: Rapid. Multiple frontier model releases in 2026. Assessed during weekly deep scans.
ai_acceleration.note: Lumina assesses during weekly deep scan by searching for recent model releases, capability benchmarks, and regulatory actions. Updated weekly.

public_sentiment.name: Public Sentiment
public_sentiment.note: Live from FRED. Enriched with social sentiment during deep scans.
